MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The cup magnets fit my recent interest in magnetic hooks because they offer a related way to attach fixtures to metal surfaces.",
    "Their included screws make them relevant to the mounting and fastening supplies I recently chose, although I would still need to add hooks or fixtures."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wire connectors, heat shrink tubing, and multimeter leads assume an electrical project that my recent fastener and magnetic hook purchases do not establish.",
    "The temperature controller, cutting wheels, and cleaning brush serve tasks I have shown no current need for.",
    "The older hand truck purchase does not mean I need replacement caster wheels now, and ten packs of glue would exceed my needs without a specific project."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations treat general workshop usefulness as enough reason for me to want an item, even when it solves a different problem.",
    "My purchase of screws described for electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in wiring and electrical testing."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Two magnetic hook purchases close together are a stronger clue to my current interest in magnetic mounting than the much older hand truck purchase.",
    "Ready-made hooks matter: plain cup magnets are relevant, but they require extra parts to provide the hanging function I recently selected.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear immediate use, so a loosely related tool or large supply pack is unlikely to interest me."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in magnetic mounting but stretched it into unrelated workshop projects."
}
